item.title: Cold December pattern and more systems ahead | Dec. 6, 2025
item.description: December has started cold and tricky, with a series of quick moving systems bringing a mix of rain, snow, and freezing rain, with minor accumulations and nuisance travel, followed by a brief but sharp shot of cold and a stronger wave of rain and snow midweek.
